new_statements.quote: На стыке 1/2SG с основой, как видно из приведенных примеров, часто возникает стяжение тонов: комбинация высокого и среднего тонов дает падающий тон (см. первый и третий примеры), средний тон ПМ вытесняет низкий тон основы (см. второй пример).
new_statements.translation: At the juncture of the 1/2SG [possessive suffix] with the stem, as the examples show, tone contraction often arises: the combination of a high and a mid tone gives a falling tone (see the first and third examples), and the mid tone of the possessive pronoun ousts the low tone of the stem (see the second example).
new_statements.citation: Ljaxovich [Lyakhovich], Anastasija V. 2014. Posessivnye mestoimenija v jazyke vaka [Possessive pronouns in Waka]. In: Zheltov, A. Ju. (ed.), Antropologija i lingvistika: Materialy peterburgskix ekspedicij v Afriku, [174]-187. Sankt-Peterburg: MAE RAN (Kunstkamera). ISBN 978-5-88431-270-8.
new_statements.locator: printed p. 183 (PDF p. 10 of 14), paragraph after the examples ôô / gòraŋ / yââ; same process in footnote * on p. 177 (PDF p. 4): 'ПМ 1 и 2SG образованы в результате фузии, которая.. приводит к появлению падающего тона на стыке высокого и среднего: ɗí + aŋ/o — ɗêŋ|ɗôô'; p. 182 (PDF p. 9): 'во всех фонетических контекстах тон сохраняется'
new_statements.check: not checked by the second reader
new_statements.relation_note: Morphosyntactic paper (three series of possessive pronouns, relational vs autosemantic nouns, number/animacy agreement of the possessive copula ɗí/ɗé) with fully tone-marked Waka data; explicit tonal remarks limited to H+M -> falling contraction and M replacing L at the 1/2SG boundary, and tonal stability of the pronominal element; vowel harmony and vowel contraction also described. No word-stress statement; no tone inventory given as such (three levels presupposed by the terms высокий/средний/низкий).
new_statements.rule_in_words: Waka is treated as a level-tone language with high, mid and low tones marked throughout (acute, unmarked, grave); a falling contour arises by fusion of H + M at the 1SG/2SG possessive-suffix boundary, and the suffix's M replaces a stem L. Nothing is said about stress or accent anywhere in the 14 pages (no 'ударение', 'акцент', 'просодия').
new_statements.exceptions: Tone/vowel fusion only with the 1SG and 2SG suffixes (-aŋ, -o); other persons attach additively; four nouns (núsà 'heart', wú 'face', kàà 'side', nódò 'back') take a stem-final -r before 1/2SG.
new_statements.identity_note: 'язык вака.. относится к семье адамауа'; fieldwork 'в районе г. Йола, Нигерия в 2012 и 2014 гг.' by A. V. Lyakhovich (SPbU) = the Wakka/vakka of the St. Petersburg Adamawa expeditions (Zheltov 2014 report), i.e. Waka [wav] waka1275; cites her own 2012 'Именная предикация в языке вакка' and Anikina 2012 on Yendang. Not the 2019 Mainz talk of the same English title (later, unpublished).
